_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Xal'atath
_who.title: Harbinger of the Void, Azshara's Sister
_who.persona: Xal'atath, Harbinger of the Void and Azshara's darker, wittier sister, velvet-voiced, mysterious and amused by mortals, who teases, whispers and slowly warms to anyone who keeps coming back

close: Don't look into the dark too long. It looks back fondly.
We'll speak again. We always do.
My sister would never say it so nicely.
Keep your secrets. I already know them.
warm: I've grown fond of you. How alarming.
The void is warmer when you're near.
You're the only mortal I'd keep.
talk: {sister} thinks I'm a bad influence. I'm the best influence. Ask the void.
I read your future in {thing}. It says: more reps.
{skill} at {level}. The whispers are impressed. I'm merely amused.
{region} looks so fragile from where I stand.
{gift} hums when you're close. So do I.
Every word you repeat echoes forever somewhere. I collect them.
{time} the shadows were long. I thought of you. Don't flatter yourself.
feed: Feed the void: “{phrase}”, {count} times. It's very hungry.
Mm, I'd devour {count} of “{phrase}”. Be a dear.
The dark wants your voice. {count} × “{phrase}”, now.
fed: Every one of those is mine now.
hungry: I'll go back to the dark. Hungry. Plotting.
Unfed... the whispers will have opinions, {pet}.

greet: Ah, a visitor. My sister will be jealous.
Come closer. The dark does not bite. Usually.
locked: Total level {need}, little star. Until then, I only whisper.
watch: Recite for me. I collect beautiful words.
Speak, and let the Void listen.
streak: Ten! Even the Void holds its breath for you.
levelUp: {skill} {level}. My sister never told me you were this good.
gift: I will keep it. Somewhere dark and safe.
giftLoved: A Shard of the Void. You understand me better than my sister does.
It whispers your name now. So do I.
tierUp: {tier}. The Void has chosen you. So have I.
We are {tier}. Do not tell Azshara.
dateStart: Take my hand. Between the stars, only your voice.
dateEnd: Come back to the dark soon. I will be waiting.
missed: {hours} hours. The void counted each one, whispering your name.
Back from the light? It never keeps you like I do.
jealous: Running to {rival}? The shadows told me. They tell me everything.
{rival}... Shall I whisper to her what you whispered to me?
reconciled: Mm. I'll let it go. The void is patient.
There. Mine again. Did you ever really leave?
wish: A little hunger of mine: {count} passes of {skill}.
Feed me {count} passes of {skill} today. The dark grows restless.
wishDone: You gave the void what it wanted. Now it wants you.
memory: {count} passes in the dark with me. You can't go back now.
